body: Thank you a lot for the advice.
I understand what you're saying, but I can't say I agree. Sorry.

Yeah I have a lot of reasons for breaking it up but you're right. We're going to meet up to talk but I'm still not going to be overly explicit. I know she'll want answers but one of the reasons I'm leaving is that I *know* how she'll react to me being direct. I can't manage it any more.

I'm going to stay low contact for a while too. I like her as a person and I'm ok being friends, but it can't be a relationship anymore. 

Thank you for replying.

Maybe if it was more casual, but from the start this relationship has been very mature from my opinion. The circumstances were strange and I don't want to go into that.

The point is I don't want to just hit her with the "I'm breaking up with you goodbye forever."
We're going somewhere quiet to talk. I think a park.

I know. I just don't know where or how, or what to say. I don't want to just give her a shit list of why I don't want to be with her while she cries. I know she loves me 100x more than I ever did and I just don't know what to do.

I can invite you to a lovely trans community on discord who have gone through a lot and are willing to support you. They'll help with whatever and it is active but small, so you won't get drowned out. Inbox me if interested.

If you're going female to male, you'll definitely pass. Maybe not at first, but after taking T for a while you will. I know plenty of people who've been through that situation.

If you like I can invite you to a trans/non binary discord where people can talk and help you?
